load_nist_mt_module: load the nist_mt evaluation module using evaluate.load for machine translation scoring
launch_gradio_widget: launch a gradio widget for the nist_mt evaluation module with an interactive UI
run_nist_mt_evaluation: run the nist_mt metric to evaluate machine translation output against reference translations
compute_nist_score: compute the NIST mt score for a set of translated sentences compared to reference translations
integrate_nist_mt_metric: integrate the nist_mt metric into a huggingface evaluate pipeline for translation quality assessment
